title: Card kinds: the next merges landed

chat.text: Merges 4 (popovers) and 5 (folds) landed, proven with shots at 1920 and 390. 6 regions, 7 ai-pills and 8 frames are deferred on purpose.

message.text:
**Landed:** merge 4 popovers (menu panel, tooltip bubble, undo toast now wear `.ux-popover`) and merge 5 folds (accordion item and the AI task fold are one `details.ui-accordion-item`, rules owned by `ui/accordion`). Both shot at 1920 and 390, padding-check clean, no new console errors.

**Deferred, with reasons in the task log:**
- 6 regions: the plan's swap redesigns 16 library sections (299 to 118px).
- 7 ai-pills: 6 AI dashboards that render no data in a worktree, and the pill-on-a-button look needs your call.
- 8 frames: `frame` has no home module yet (name and home first), and `ai/v/2` is being edited elsewhere.

Merges 11-13 not started (need two clean small merges and budget). Plan numbers: kinds 36 and padding rules 5 are plan constants, unchanged; folds and popovers now count 0 files. Todo line 111 updated. Spent about $5.2 of $15.

Note: merge 8, frames, landed (commits 6c3d4d054 / f2c37ff64). A frame is a `.surface` with the `.ui-panel-head` / `-body` / `-foot` parts, homed in /framework/ui/panel/ (no new class). Panel, dialog, the overview column on /framework/ai/v/2/ and the screenshot thumb now share it, and the overview column did not grow (399/54/340/54 px before and after). The doc files browser is left, since it wraps `ext/files` and would double-frame; plan numbers stay 36 kinds / 5 padding rules, the frames merge went from 12 files to 4. Detail: card-merge-frames/plan.md.

Merges 9 and 10 landed in part. 9: the new [row kind](/framework/ui/row/) exists and the sub-card list rows use it. 10: the needs-you strip and the owner prompt bubble are now cards. The other AI rows and cards stay as they were because the plan's own numbers show a redesign, not a box swap; each is named in the [plan](/framework/ux/Content/plan/) and the [run notes](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/card-merges-2/plan.md). These boxes don't show on any plain page load, so the proof is live probes of the real markup plus 21 pages shot before and after with no change and no new errors.

Merge 11 (the doc well) was measured and not made. Swapping it to a plain region moves the title 36px off the tab labels and splits the grey band into two colours, so it stays `.doc-well` in ext/Doc. Reasons and a proposed shared title-strip for five hand-built copies: [ext/Doc/doc/well.md](/framework/ext/Doc/doc/well.md). Merges 12 and 13 are not started.
